an4.257:1.1: athakho āyasmā māluṃkyaputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā māluṃkyaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an4.257:2.1: sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti.
an4.257:2.3: yatra hi nāma tvaṃ jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako tathāgatassa saṃkhittena ovādaṃ yācasīti.
an4.257:2.4: desetu me bhante bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu sugato saṃkhittena dhammaṃ appevanāmāhaṃ bhagavato bhāsitassa atthaṃ jāneyyaṃ appevanāmāhaṃ bhagavato bhāsitassa dāyādo assanti.
an4.257:3.1: cattārome māluṃkyaputta taṇhuppādā yattha bhikkhuno taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati
an4.257:3.3: cīvarahetu vā māluṃkyaputta bhikkhuno taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati
an4.257:3.4: piṇḍapātahetu vā māluṃkyaputta bhikkhuno taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati
an4.257:3.5: senāsanahetu vā māluṃkyaputta bhikkhuno taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati
an4.257:3.6: itibhavābhavahetu vā māluṃkyaputta bhikkhuno taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati
an4.257:3.7: ime kho māluṃkyaputta cattāro taṇhuppādā yattha bhikkhuno taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati
an4.257:3.8: yato kho māluṃkyaputta bhikkhuno taṇhā pahīnā hoti ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃanuppādadhammā ayaṃ vuccati māluṃkyaputta bhikkhu acchejji taṇhaṃ vivaṭṭayi saññojanaṃ sammāmānābhisamayā antamakāsi dukkhassāti.
an4.257:4.1: athakho āyasmā māluṃkyaputto bhagavatā iminā ovādena ovadito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
an4.257:4.2: athakho āyasmā māluṃkyaputto eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi
an4.257:4.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi
an4.257:4.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā māluṃkyaputto arahataṃ ahosīti.
